thread:
Lea: Quick async pulse — I'm consolidating the telemetry roadmap for the next 6wk sprint. Need owners + current ETA for these items by EOD: 1) per-route dashboard (latency + cost), 2) tracing hooks (sampling + span naming), 3) error-analysis views (grouping + regressions), 4) retention change (90d -> 180d) and rough storage/cost delta. Reply with short status and blockers.

Omar: I'm taking the per-route dashboard. ETA for MVP (minimal metrics + list) is 2w — target 2021-03-28. Blocker: need stable API endpoints for queries and one frontend slot. Will post proto tomorrow.

Jia: Frontend can take the slot. I'll allocate 1 FE engineer for 2 sprints. Need the API contract (fields, filters, pagination). Also: any wireframes or sample payloads?

Omar: Will post proto => /api/telemetry/routes?start=...&end=...&group_by=route. Response will include p50/p95/tokens/cost. Draft by Mon.

Sam: Infra here — retention calc in progress. I can run a 90->180d estimate and storage delta by Tue. Heads up: traces require index changes; might need a hot vs cold tier and small infra cost bump. If we enable 180d for traces, we should quantize or compress older spans.

Priya: Tracing hooks owner check-in: Priya here. Sampling flag change is low-risk. ETA for adding standardized span naming + sampling controls: ~Apr 2. Blocker: eng-runtime needs to expose trace-id injection hook for model-runs. @eng-runtime-team can you confirm API?

Lea: Noted. For error-analysis views — who owns grouping/typedefs? thinking to reuse existing errors-service grouping logic.

Priya: I can own the grouping logic for traces -> errors mapping, but need a quick sync with errors-service owners to confirm semantics. ETA for initial grouped UI: Apr 5.

Sam: @Lea quick note: If we change retention to 180d we should run a canary on a single org first. Cost estimate will include canary plan.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Scheduled canary job `telemetry-retention-canary` for 2017001300 (single-tenant) :gear:

Jia: Wireframes: I'll sketch a simple per-route lanes view and post PNGs by Wed. Will align with Omar's proto fields.

Omar: Proto posted: gist link (short) — pls comment. I added example query and response. If no objections by Mon noon I'll freeze.

Sam: Retention numbers ready: doubling retention ~ +22% storage for metrics, +48% for traces unless we compress. Can provide a compressed vs uncompressed breakdown tomorrow.

Lea: Awesome. Quick recap / action items: Omar -> finalize API proto (due Mon noon), Jia -> wireframes (Wed), Priya -> tracing hooks + grouping (ETA Apr 2/Apr 5), Sam -> detailed retention/cost + canary plan (Tue). I'll create milestone cards and tag owners. If anyone has a hard blocker, reply here.

Omar: :thumbsup: will send PR for API docs.

Priya: ACK. Need eng-runtime contact — pinging in org channel after this.

Jia: ACK.

Sam: ACK, will include hot/cold tier options and cost per org estimate.

Lea: Thanks all — I'll synthesize and post the milestone doc in #eng-platform by EOD. Leaving this thread open for clarifications.
